name: catch the shell while it is still on the tube
how bright is the shell band vs the middle - a shell is a RING of light
eval: (function(){const cx=crt.width/2, cy=crt.height/2;const band=(r0,r1)=>{const d=ctx.getImageData(0,0,crt.width,crt.height).data;let s=0,n=0;for(let y=0;y<crt.height;y+=2)for(let x=0;x<crt.width;x+=2){const dx=x-cx,dy=y-cy,r=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(r>=r0&&r<r1){const i=(y*crt.width+x)*4;s+=d[i]+d[i+1]+d[i+2];n++;}}return n?s/n:0;};const inner=band(0,40), shell=band(140,230), out=band(240,300);return 'centre '+inner.toFixed(0)+'   shell band '+shell.toFixed(0)+'   beyond '+out.toFixed(0);})()
